units.text: Article 31. Requirements for procurement participants
units.label: Art. 31

units.text: 1. When using competitive methods, or procuring from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) in the cases provided for by points 4, 5, 18, 30, 42, 49, 54 and 59 of part 1 of Article 93 of this Federal Law, the contracting authority shall impose the following uniform requirements on procurement participants:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 1) compliance with requirements established under legislation of the Russian Federation for persons supplying the goods, performing the works or providing the services that constitute the procurement subject matter;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 2) Repealed. — Federal Law of 04.06.2014 No. 140-FZ;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 3) the participant, if a legal entity, is not being liquidated, and no commercial court has declared the participant, whether a legal entity or individual entrepreneur, insolvent (bankrupt) and opened bankruptcy liquidation proceedings;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 4) the participant’s activities have not been suspended under the Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 5) the participant has no arrears in taxes or levies, or debts in other mandatory payments to budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation for the previous calendar year exceeding twenty-five percent of the book value of its assets according to the financial statements for the latest reporting period. Excluded are amounts for which a deferral, instalment arrangement or investment tax credit has been granted under tax and levy legislation of the Russian Federation; amounts restructured under legislation of the Russian Federation; amounts covered by a final court decision recognizing the applicant’s payment obligation as fulfilled; and amounts declared uncollectible under tax and levy legislation of the Russian Federation. A participant is deemed to meet this requirement if it has appealed the arrears or debts in the prescribed manner and no decision on that appeal has been made by the date its application to participate in supplier (contractor, service provider) selection is examined;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 6) Repealed from 1 January 2014. — Federal Law of 28.12.2013 No. 396-FZ;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 7) the participant, if an individual, or the head, members of the collegial executive body, person acting as sole executive body or chief accountant of a participating legal entity, has no conviction for economic crimes and/or offences under Articles 289, 290, 291 or 291.1 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation, except convictions that have been expunged or removed. Those individuals must also not be subject to a sentence depriving them of the right to hold specified positions or engage in specified activities connected with supplying the goods, performing the works or providing the services being procured, or to the administrative penalty of disqualification;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 7.1) a participating legal entity has not, during the two years preceding submission of its application, been held administratively liable for the offence provided for by Article 19.28 of the Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 7.1 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 8) the participant holds exclusive rights to intellectual activity results if the contracting authority acquires rights to those results in connection with contract performance, except contracts for the creation of literary or artistic works or performances, or for financing distribution or screening of a national film;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 9) there are no circumstances in which an official of the contracting authority, namely its head, a procurement commission member, head of its contract service or contract manager, that official’s spouse, direct-line ascending or descending close relative (father, mother, grandfather, grandmother, son, daughter, grandson or granddaughter), full or half brother or sister sharing the same father or mother, a person adopted by that official or that official’s adoptive parent is:
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: а) an individual, including one registered as an individual entrepreneur, participating in the procurement;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: б) the head, sole executive body, member of the collegial executive body, founder or member of the collegial body of a participating unitary organization;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 9 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: в) the sole executive body, a member of the collegial executive body or collegial governing body, or a beneficiary of a participating corporate legal entity. For this Article, a beneficiary is an individual who directly or indirectly, through one or more legal entities, owns more than ten percent of the voting shares of a business company, or directly or indirectly owns an interest exceeding ten percent in the charter (pooled) capital of a business partnership or company;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 9 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 10) the participant is not an offshore company; no offshore company is a participant (member) of the corporate legal entity or founder of the unitary legal entity; and no offshore company is among the persons directly or indirectly, through one or more legal entities, holding more than ten percent of the voting shares of a business company or an interest exceeding ten percent in the charter (pooled) capital of a business partnership or company;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 10.1) the participant is not a foreign agent;
units.label: Point 10.1 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 11) the participant is not subject to restrictions on participation in procurement established by legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 31

units.text: 1.1. Unless the Government of the Russian Federation establishes otherwise, the contracting authority may require that the register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers) provided for by this Federal Law contain no information on the procurement participant, including the persons whose information is included in its application under subpoint “в” of point 1 of part 1 of Article 43 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 31

units.text: 2. The Government of the Russian Federation may establish additional requirements for participants in procurement of particular types of goods, works or services and participants in particular types of procurement, including possession of:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31

units.text: 1) financial resources to perform the contract;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 31

units.text: 2) equipment and other material resources to perform the contract, held under ownership or another lawful basis;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 31

units.text: 3) experience related to the subject matter of the contract and business reputation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 31

units.text: 4) the required number of specialists and other employees of a specified qualification level to perform the contract.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 31

units.text: 2.1. Where competitive methods are used and the initial (maximum) contract price, or total of those prices in a joint tender or auction, is twenty million rubles or more, the contracting authority shall impose an additional requirement that the participant, taking account of legal succession, has performed a contract or an agreement concluded under Federal Law of 18 July 2011 No. 223-FZ “On Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities” during the three years before applying, and has met demands for payment of contractual penalties (fines and delay penalties) made during its performance. This does not apply where additional requirements for participants have been established by the Government of the Russian Federation under part 2 of this Article. The value of obligations performed under that contract or agreement must be at least twenty percent of the initial (maximum) contract price.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 31

units.text: 3. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish the list of information and documents confirming participants’ compliance with the additional requirements specified in parts 2 and 2.1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 31

units.text: 4. Where the Government of the Russian Federation establishes additional requirements for participants under part 2 of this Article, contracting authorities must impose those requirements when selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers).
units.label: Part 4 Art. 31

units.text: 5. The contracting authority shall specify the requirements imposed under parts 1, 1.1, 2 and 2.1 of this Article in the procurement notice and procurement documentation, where such documentation is provided for by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 31

units.text: 6. Contracting authorities may not impose requirements on procurement participants in breach of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 31

units.text: 7. The requirements specified in this Article shall apply equally to all procurement participants.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 31

units.text: 8. The procurement commission, or the contracting authority when procuring from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) in the cases provided for by part 1 of this Article, shall verify compliance with points 1 and 7.1, point 10 except in electronic procedures, and point 10.1 of part 1, and part 1.1 where that requirement is imposed, of this Article, and with parts 2 and 2.1 where additional requirements have been imposed under parts 2 and 2.1 of this Article. The commission, or contracting authority when procuring from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) in the cases provided for by part 1 of this Article, may verify compliance with points 3–5, 7, 8, 9 and 11 of part 1 of this Article and, in electronic procedures, with point 10 of part 1. The commission or contracting authority may not require participants to confirm compliance with those requirements, except requirements established by the Government of the Russian Federation under parts 2 and 2.1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 31

units.text: 8.1. Repealed from 1 July 2018. — Federal Law of 31.12.2017 No. 504-FZ.
units.label: Part 8.1 Art. 31

units.text: 8.2. Repealed from 1 January 2022. — Federal Law of 02.07.2021 No. 360-FZ.
units.label: Part 8.2 Art. 31

units.text: 9. The procurement commission must exclude a participant from supplier (contractor, service provider) selection at any time up to and including the date the results are determined if it discovers that the participant does not meet requirements imposed under part 1 or under parts 1.1, 2 and 2.1 of this Article where such requirements are imposed, and/or has supplied unreliable information on its compliance. If, after the results are determined and before the contract is concluded under this Federal Law, the contracting authority discovers that the participant does not meet requirements imposed under part 1 or under parts 1.1, 2 and 2.1 of this Article where such requirements are imposed, and/or has supplied unreliable information on its compliance, or unreliable information and/or documents in the participant’s application, it must refuse to conclude the contract with that participant.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 31

units.text: 10. In procurement of medicinal products included in the list of vital and essential medicines, in addition to the grounds provided for by part 9 of this Article, a participant shall be excluded from supplier (contractor, service provider) selection or conclusion of a contract with the winner shall be refused at any time before conclusion if the contracting authority or procurement commission discovers that:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 31

units.text: 1) the maximum ex-factory price of the medicines offered by that participant has not been registered;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 31

units.text: 2) the participant’s proposed price for the medicines exceeds their maximum ex-factory price recorded in the state register of manufacturers’ maximum ex-factory prices for medicines on the list of vital and essential medicines, and the participant refuses to reduce its price when concluding the contract. This applies where the participant is the manufacturer, or where the initial (maximum) contract price exceeds ten million rubles for procurement to meet federal needs, or exceeds the amount set by the highest executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, which may not exceed ten million rubles, for procurement to meet that constituent entity’s or municipal needs.
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 31

units.text: 10.1. Part 10 of this Article shall not apply when selecting a medicinal product supplier with whom a contract with reciprocal investment obligations is concluded under Article 111.4 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 10.1 Art. 31

units.text: 11. If the contracting authority refuses to conclude a contract with the winner of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection on the grounds provided for by parts 9 and 10 of this Article, it shall, no later than the working day following establishment of the relevant fact, generate through the unified information system a record of refusal, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf, and publish it in that system. The record shall state the identification number of the winner’s application, the fact constituting grounds for refusal and the identifying details of documents confirming it. The contracting authority shall send the record to that winner within two working days of signing it. It may conclude a contract with another participant that offered the same contract price or total of unit prices of goods, works or services as the winner, or the next best price or total of unit prices after the winner’s terms, following the procedure for concluding a contract where the winner evades conclusion. If refusal is based on point 2 of part 10 of this Article, the winner shall be deemed to have evaded conclusion of the contract.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 31

units.text: 12. A decision to exclude a participant from supplier (contractor, service provider) selection, or to refuse to conclude a contract with the winner, may be appealed by that participant or winner under the procedure established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.label: Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 1. The contracting authority shall use the following criteria to evaluate participants’ applications:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 1) contract price or total of unit prices of goods, works or services;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 2) costs of operating and repairing goods and using the results of works;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 3) quality, functional and environmental characteristics of the procurement subject matter;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 4) qualifications of procurement participants, including financial resources, equipment and other material resources held under ownership or another lawful basis, experience related to the contract subject matter, business reputation, and specialists and other employees of a specified qualification level.
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 2. Repealed. — Federal Law of 03.08.2018 No. 311-FZ.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 3. In the cases provided for by part 16 of Article 34 of this Federal Law and other cases established by the Government of the Russian Federation, the contracting authority may evaluate applications using the life-cycle cost of goods or of a facility created through performance of works instead of the criteria in points 1 and 2 of part 1 of this Article. Life-cycle cost shall be calculated taking account of the methodological recommendations provided for by part 20 of Article 22 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 4. The contracting authority must specify in the procurement notice and procurement documentation, where this Federal Law provides for such documentation, the criteria and their weights used to select a supplier (contractor, service provider). Except in auctions, at least two criteria must be used, one of which shall be the contract price or total of unit prices of goods, works or services. Criteria or weights not specified in the notice and procurement documentation, where required, may not be used to evaluate applications.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 5. The weights of all criteria used shall total one hundred percent. The weight of the criterion specified in point 2 of part 1 of this Article must not exceed the weight of the criterion specified in point 1 of part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 6. When selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers) for contracts for performances as results of intellectual activity, for financing distribution or screening of a national film, or for research, experimental design or technological work, the combined weight of the criteria in points 1 and 2 of part 1 of this Article must be at least twenty percent of the total weight of all criteria, except in the case provided for by part 8 of Article 37 of this Federal Law. If the criterion in point 2 of part 1 of this Article is not used for those contracts, the weight of the criterion in point 1 of part 1 of this Article must be at least twenty percent of the total, except in the case provided for by part 8 of Article 37 of this Federal Law. When selecting a performer for a contract to create a literary or artistic work, the weight of the criterion in point 1 of part 1 of this Article may be reduced to zero percent of the total.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 7. The provisions of this Federal Law concerning literary and artistic works shall apply to:
units.label: Part 7 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 1) literary works;
units.label: Point 1 Part 7 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 2) dramatic and musical-dramatic works and scripts;
units.label: Point 2 Part 7 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 3) choreographic works and pantomime;
units.label: Point 3 Part 7 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 4) musical works with or without lyrics;
units.label: Point 4 Part 7 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 5) audiovisual works;
units.label: Point 5 Part 7 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 6) works of painting, sculpture, graphic art and design, graphic narratives, comics and other works of visual art;
units.label: Point 6 Part 7 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 7) works of decorative and applied art and stage design;
units.label: Point 7 Part 7 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 8) works of architecture, urban planning and landscape architecture, namely a facility’s external and internal appearance and spatial, layout and functional organization recorded as diagrams or models or described in another manner, excluding design documentation;
units.label: Point 8 Part 7 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Evaluation of procurement participants' applications and criteria for that evaluation
units.text: 9) photographic works and works produced by methods analogous to photography;
units.label: Point 9 Part 7 Art. 32
